US policy change targets Indian IT firms, sparking export concerns

The United States under the Trump administration announced a change to employer‑sponsored permanent residency rules that has been described by GTRI as a protectionist shift raising concerns for India's IT exports, while analysts note that the sector's direct exposure may be smaller than headlines suggest and that the greatest losses could fall on other parties.
